ti.ቆልዑ፡ ኣብ ጥቓ ቤት ትምህርቲ ወይ መጻወቲ: Children – near a school or playground
ti.ከብቲ ኣብ ጽርግያ ክህልዉ ይኽእሉ: Cattle may be on the road
ti.ኣባጊዕ ኣብ ጽርግያ ክህልዋ ይኽእላ: Sheep may be on the road
ti.መስቀላ ጽርግያ ኣብ ቅድሚ፡ ሕጊ የማን ይሰርሕ: Crossing ahead – the right-hand rule applies
ti.ኣብቲ ዝመጽእ መስቀላ ቅድሚ ኣሎካ: You have priority at the next crossing
ti.ክልተ ኣንፈት ትራፊክ፡ ካብ ቅድሚ መካይን ይመጽኣ: Two-way traffic – cars come towards you
ti.ቀይሕን ብጫን ብሓባር፡ ገና ደው በል፡ ቀልጢፉ ቀጠልያ ክኸውን: Red and yellow together – still stop, green is coming soon
ti.ብጫ ጥራይ፡ ብውሑስ ክትክእል እንተኾንካ ደው በል: Yellow only – stop if you can do it safely
ti.ምሉእ ብጫ መስመር፡ ኣይትሰግሮ: Solid yellow line – do not cross
ti.ዝተቖራረጸ ብጫ መስመር፡ ብጥንቃቐ ክትሰግሮ ትኽእል: Broken yellow line – you may cross carefully
ti.ብትሑት ማርሻ ኪድ፡ ፍረኖ ብዙሕ ከይተሞቕ: Use a low gear so the brakes do not overheat
ti.ቀስ በል፡ ምስ ዝመጽእ ትራፊክ ተሰማማዕ: Slow down and adjust to oncoming traffic
ti.ቀስ በል፡ ብሃንደበት ፍረኖን መሪሕን ኣይትግበር: Slow down – no sudden braking or steering
ti.ቀስ በል፡ ንሰራሕተኛታትን ምልክታትን ተኸተል: Slow down – follow the workers and signs
ti.ደው ክትብል ተዳሎ፡ ንእግረኛታት ተጠንቀቕ: Be ready to stop – watch for pedestrians
ti.ብዙሕ ቀስ በል፡ ቆልዑ ብሃንደበት ክሰግሩ ይኽእሉ: Slow down a lot – children may cross suddenly
ti.ንትራም ተጠንቀቕ፡ ቅድሚ ሃቦ: Watch for the tram – give way to it
ti.ካብ የማን ንዝመጽእ ቅድሚ ሃብ: Give way to traffic from the right
ti.ቀስ በል፡ ኣብ ልዕሊ ሓዲድ ደው ኣይትበል: Slow down – never stop on the tracks
ti.ቀስ በል፡ ባቡር ከይመጸ ጸጋምን የማንን ርአ: Slow down – look left and right for a train
ti.ቀስ በል፡ ኣብ ሮቶንዳ ዘለዉ ቅድሚ ሃቦም: Slow down – give way to those in the roundabout
ti.ብየማን ጎድኒ ሓዝ፡ ካብ ቅድሚ ትራፊክ ኣሎ: Keep right – there is oncoming traffic
ti.ቀስ በል፡ ደው ክትብል ተዳሎ: Slow down – be ready to stop
ti.ኣብ መስመር ደው ምባል ምሉእ ብምሉእ ደው በል: Stop completely at the stop line
ti.ቅድሚ ኣሎካ፡ ግን ብጥንቃቐ ኪድ: You have priority, but drive carefully
ti.ሕጊ የማን ደጊሙ ይሰርሕ፡ ተጠንቀቕ: The right-hand rule applies again – be careful
ti.እዚ ምልክት ኣብ ጽርግያ እንታይ ማለት እዩ?: What does this road marking mean?
ti.እዚ ምልክት ካብ ኣየናይ ዓይነት እዩ?: What kind of sign is this?
ti.ነዚ ምልክት ምስ ረኣኻ እንታይ ትገብር?: What do you do when you see this sign?

rules: In town, if there is no speed sign, what is the highest allowed speed?
Without a sign it is 50 km/h in town.
Outside town, if there is no sign, what is the highest speed?
Outside town without a sign it is 80 km/h.
What is the highest speed allowed on any road in Norway?
On some motorways up to 110 km/h is allowed, but only when signed.
What is the allowed blood alcohol level in Norway?
The limit is 0.2 per mille. Best advice: if you drink, do not drive.
At a crossing without signs, who goes first?
Right-hand rule: give way to cars coming from your right.
Below what height does a child need a special child seat?
Children under 135 cm must sit in a special child seat.
May you hold and use your phone while driving?
No. You may only talk with a hands-free device.
What is the minimum tread depth for winter tyres?
Winter tyres must have at least 3 mm tread.
What is the minimum tread depth for summer tyres?
Summer tyres must have at least 1.6 mm.
In Norway, when must the car lights be on?
In Norway you always drive with lights on, day and night.
Someone wants to cross at a pedestrian crossing (zebra). What do you do?
You must give way to a pedestrian who is on or wants to step onto the crossing.
Who in the car must use a seat belt?
Everyone. The driver is responsible for passengers under 15.
An ambulance or police comes with blue lights and siren. What do you do?
Give room so it can pass
Stop in the middle of the road
Move carefully to the side and give room so it can pass.
What does a triangle sign pointing down (red border) mean?
It means give way: let the traffic on the other road pass.
After getting a new licence, how long is the probation period?
New drivers have a 2-year probation period. Mistakes count more in this time.
How many questions does the class B theory test have, and how many mistakes are allowed?
45 questions in 90 minutes. You pass with up to 7 mistakes.
What does the red octagon sign «STOP» mean?
At STOP you must stop completely, then give way to all traffic.
What does a yellow diamond sign with a white border mean?
You are on a main road
You are on a main road – traffic from side roads must give way to you.
If you see the yellow diamond sign crossed out with a black line, what does it mean?
The main road ends – the right-hand rule applies again.
What does a blue round sign generally show?
Blue round signs show an order, for example «Turn right only».
more: In general, what does a round sign with a red border show?
Round signs with a red border show a prohibition, for example «No entry».
What kind of sign is a triangle pointing up with a red border?
It is a warning sign: it tells you there is a danger ahead.
Who has priority when you enter a roundabout?
Cars already in the roundabout have priority – you wait.
What do you do when you leave a roundabout?
Indicate right when you leave, so others know.
What distance to the car in front is advised?
The «3-second rule» – and more in rain or snow.
On which side do you normally overtake a car?
You normally overtake on the left.
May you overtake a car on or just before a pedestrian crossing?
Overtaking on or just before a pedestrian crossing is not allowed.
Within how many metres before a pedestrian crossing may you not park?
Do not park within 5 metres before a pedestrian crossing.
On a road of 60 km/h or less, a bus indicates to leave the stop. What do you do?
On roads of 60 km/h or less you must let a bus leave the stop.
When you meet a tram, who generally has priority?
In general you must give way to the tram.
What must you have in the car in Norway?
A warning triangle and a high-visibility vest
A warning triangle and a high-visibility vest must be in the car.
Which number do you call for an ambulance in Norway?
What do you do first at a traffic accident?
First make the scene safe, then call for help, then help.
Your car floats on a lot of water (aquaplaning). What do you do?
Release the gas and keep the wheel straight
Release the gas and keep the wheel straight until the car grips the road again.
You must stop in an emergency (car with ABS). What do you do?
Press the brake hard and hold it
Press and release the brake again and again
With ABS: press the brake hard and keep it pressed.
You get sleepy while driving. What is best?
The real solution is rest and sleep.
What does a red triangle on a medicine package mean?
A red triangle on medicine means it can affect your driving.
What does a warning sign with a wild animal (like a moose) mean?
Wild animals may cross – be careful
Wild animals may cross the road, especially in the evening and morning.
You hit a large wild animal (moose or deer). What do you do?
If you hit a large animal you must report it to the police.
What happens to the stopping distance on snow or ice?
On ice the stopping distance can be many times longer.
In most of Norway, when are studded tyres allowed?
From 1 November to the first Monday after Easter
Generally from 1 November to the first Monday after Easter. It is longer in northern Norway.
May a rear-facing child seat be placed in front of an active airbag?
No. The airbag can seriously injure the child.
Until what age is it advised that children sit facing backwards?
It is advised up to 4 years – it is much safer.
What do you do before changing lanes?
Mirrors, indicate, look over your shoulder
Mirrors, indicator, then look over your shoulder to see the blind spot.
How do you merge when two lanes become one?
The first to arrive goes in
Take turns, one from each lane (like a zipper)
Take turns, one from each lane, like a zipper.
You turn left at a crossing and a car comes towards you. What do you do?
When turning left, give way to oncoming traffic.
You turn into another road and pedestrians or cyclists are crossing it. What do you do?
Give way to pedestrians and cyclists crossing the road you turn into.
How much space should you leave when overtaking a cyclist?
What does a steady yellow traffic light mean?
Stop if you can do it safely
Yellow means stop, unless you cannot stop safely.
What does a flashing yellow light mean?
Go carefully: signs and the right-hand rule apply.
At night a car comes towards you. What do you do?
Switch to low beam so you do not dazzle the other driver.
When do you use the rear fog light?
Only in thick fog or heavy snow
Only in thick fog or snow – and switch it off so you do not dazzle others.
What is not allowed in a tunnel?
U-turns and reversing are not allowed in a tunnel.
What is not allowed on a motorway?
Reversing and U-turns are not allowed on a motorway.
How high should the head restraint be?
Its top level with the top of your head
The top of the head restraint should be level with the top of your head.
May a child under 140 cm sit in front of an active airbag?
Children under 140 cm may not sit in front of an active airbag.
About how much alcohol does the body burn per hour?
About 0.15 per mille per hour. Coffee or water does not make it faster.
With a class B licence, up to what total weight may you drive a car?
With a class B licence, how many passengers (besides the driver) may you take?
Up to 8 passengers besides the driver.
How often must a car go to the technical inspection (EU control)?
A new car after 4 years, then every 2 years.
From what age may you practise driving in Norway?
Practice driving is allowed from 16, the licence from 18.
What must the person who practises with a learner fulfil?
At least 25 and held a licence for more than 5 years
At least 25 years old and has held a licence for more than 5 years.
What must you finish before you start practising?
The basic traffic course (with first aid)
First you must finish the basic traffic course.
Which course is mandatory in class B training?
The course in driving in the dark is mandatory.
What must you do before driving in winter?
Clear all windows, mirrors and lights of snow and ice
All windows, mirrors and lights must be clear.
A car in front of you indicates left and stands in the middle. May you pass it on the right?
Yes, carefully if there is room
You may pass a car waiting to turn left on its right side, if there is room.
On a road without a pavement, on which side should pedestrians walk?
On the left, facing oncoming traffic
Pedestrians walk on the left side so they see oncoming traffic.
What is the top speed when towing a trailer without brakes?
A trailer without brakes: up to 60 km/h.
What is the usual top speed with a braked trailer?
A braked trailer: up to 80 km/h, unless a sign shows lower.
May you park on a main road outside built-up areas?
Parking on a main road outside built-up areas is not allowed.
Within how many metres of a crossing may you not park?
Do not park within 5 metres of a crossing.
How fast may you drive in a play street (residential area with a play sign)?
In such an area you drive only at walking speed.
At 80 km/h, how far does the car travel in one second?
80 km/h is about 22 metres per second. Reaction time adds distance.
When the speed doubles, how much does the braking distance (roughly) grow?
The braking distance becomes four times longer when the speed doubles.
What does the stopping distance consist of?
Stopping distance = reaction distance + braking distance.
When may you use high beam?
When there is no car coming towards you or in front of you
Only when there is no other traffic, so you do not dazzle others.
Your car breaks down on a motorway. What do you do first?
Hazard lights, put on the vest, place the triangle
Hazard lights, vest, triangle. Passengers wait behind the barrier.
An injured person breathes but is unconscious. What do you do?
Put them on their side (recovery position) and call 113
Put them in a car quickly
Put them on their side so the airway stays open, and call 113.
An injured person is not breathing. What do you do?
Call 113 and start CPR (30 chest presses, 2 breaths)
Call 113, start 30 chest compressions and 2 breaths.
What do you do with heavy bleeding?
Press directly and hard on the wound.
In Norway, how many penalty points within 3 years make you lose your licence?
8 points within 3 years: you lose your licence for 6 months.
How are points counted during the probation period?
During the probation period points count double.
Must you carry your licence when you drive?
Your licence must be with you when you drive.
What sign must the car have during practice driving?
During practice driving there must be a learner sign at the back of the car.
What do you do when you enter a motorway?
Match the speed of the traffic on the slip lane and give way to those already on it
Go straight to the left lane
Match your speed to the traffic; cars on the motorway have priority.
Why is it dangerous to stay on the right of a truck that turns right?
The driver cannot see you (blind spot)
A truck driver cannot see who is on the right side.
What does worn tyre tread increase?
The risk of aquaplaning and skidding
Worn tyres increase the danger on water and snow.
Smooth driving and correct tyre pressure
Smooth driving and correct tyre pressure save fuel.
Leaving the engine running while you wait (without need)?
It is bad for the environment – turn it off
Idling without need harms the environment.
Do you indicate when you enter a roundabout?
Yes – to the right when you leave
Most important: indicate right when you leave the roundabout.
In rain or snow, your distance to the car in front?
In bad conditions keep a longer distance – the braking distance gets longer.
A person with a white cane (blind) is crossing the road?
Stop and let them cross carefully.
A school bus has stopped and children are getting off?
Slow down and be careful of the children
Children may cross suddenly – slow down and be careful.
Your car breaks down in a tunnel?
Hazard lights, turn off the engine, go to an emergency phone or exit
Wait in the middle of the road
Hazard lights, turn off the engine, use the emergency phone or leave through an exit.
Near a school in town, what is the usual speed?
Near schools it is often 30 km/h – follow the sign.
A traffic police officer signals with the hand, but the light is green. Who do you follow?
The police officer's signal is above lights, signs and rules.
A traffic light and a road sign say different things. Which do you follow?
The traffic light is above the road sign.
What does red and yellow together mean?
Stop and turn off the engine
The light will turn green – but do not go yet
Red and yellow means green is coming. Wait until green shows.
Only the yellow light is on (steady). What must you do?
Stop if you can do it safely
Yellow means stop – only go through if you cannot stop without danger.
The yellow light is flashing. What does it mean?
Flashing yellow means go carefully: signs and the right-hand rule apply.
A green arrow to the right is lit. What does it mean?
A green arrow means you may go in the direction of the arrow.
There is a solid line in the middle of the road. May you cross it?
You may not cross or drive on a solid line.
What does a broken line in the middle of the road mean?
You may cross it if it is safe
You may cross a broken line when it is safe.
What does a warning line (long dashes, short gaps) tell you?
A solid line or danger is near – be careful, do not overtake
A warning line tells you a solid line or a place you cannot see is near.
In Norway, what do yellow lines on the road separate?
Yellow lines separate oncoming and outgoing traffic. White is for one direction.
What do white lines between lanes separate?
White lines separate lanes going in the same direction.
May a normal car drive in a bus lane (kollektivfelt)?
Yes, if you are in a hurry
The bus lane is for buses and taxis. Normal cars are not allowed unless a sign allows it.
When may you use the horn?
To hurry someone at the lights
Use the horn only to warn of danger.
In Norway, when must the car lights be on?
Low beam or daytime running lights must always be on when you drive.
When must you switch off the high beam (fjernlys)?
Switch to low beam when you meet oncoming traffic or drive close behind someone.
When is the rear fog light (tåkebaklys) allowed?
Only in thick fog or snow with poor visibility
Use the rear fog light only when visibility is very poor – it dazzles those behind you.
Your car breaks down on a main road. What comes first?
Turn on hazard lights, put on the vest, place the warning triangle
Sit in the car and wait
Use the horn again and again
Leave the car in the middle
Hazard lights, vest and the warning triangle warn others.
Is a high-visibility vest required in the car in Norway?
Yes, one vest for the driver
One high-visibility vest for the driver must be in the car.
Is a warning triangle required in the car?
A warning triangle must be in the car.
When do you use the hazard lights (nødblink)?
When parking where it is not allowed
When the car breaks down or there is danger, or to warn of a sudden queue on the motorway
Hazard lights are for danger or to warn traffic behind you.
A pedestrian starts to cross at a pedestrian crossing (gangfelt). What do you do?
A pedestrian on or starting to cross has priority.
May you overtake another car just before a pedestrian crossing?
Overtaking just before or on a pedestrian crossing is not allowed.
Within how many metres before a pedestrian crossing may you not park?
No parking on a pedestrian crossing or within 5 metres before it.
On a two-way road, on which side do you park?
On the right in the direction of traffic
Park on the right side in the direction of traffic.
A tram (trikk) is coming at a crossing. Who goes first?
You, if you come from the right
In general you must give way to the tram.
An ambulance with blue lights and siren is coming. What do you do?
Move aside safely and give way
Give way to emergency vehicles with blue lights as well as you can.
In town (60 km/h or less) a bus indicates to leave the stop. What do you do?
At 60 km/h or less you must give way to a bus leaving the stop.
When leaving a roundabout (rundkjøring), which way do you indicate?
When leaving a roundabout, indicate right.
Entering a roundabout with a give-way sign, who has priority?
With a give-way sign, those already in the roundabout have priority.
How do you merge when lanes join (fletting)?
One by one like a zipper (glidelås)
When lanes join, merge one by one like a zipper.
What must you do before changing lanes?
Check mirrors, indicate, look over your shoulder into the blind spot
Mirrors, indicator and a look over your shoulder into the blind spot are all needed.
What does the 3-second rule help with?
Keeping distance to the car in front
Keep at least 3 seconds to the car in front.
If your speed doubles, how does the braking distance change?
Braking distance grows with the square of the speed: double speed – four times the braking distance.
What does the stopping distance (stopplengde) consist of?
Stopping distance = reaction distance + braking distance.
What is the usual reaction time for an alert driver?
Usually about 1 second – longer when tired or on the phone.
The tyres slide on water (vannplaning). What do you do?
Lift off the gas and hold the wheel straight
Lift off the gas and hold the wheel straight until the tyres touch the road again.
Your car skids on ice (skrens). Where do you look?
Look where you want to go and steer there.
How do you brake in an emergency in a car with ABS?
With ABS press hard and hold – you can still steer.
You are tired while driving. What do you do?
Open the window and go on
Stop in a safe place and rest or sleep
Tiredness is dangerous. Stop and rest.
What does a red triangle on a medicine box mean?
A red triangle means the medicine can reduce your ability to drive.
What usually happens if you have more than 0.5 per mille alcohol in your blood?
You lose your licence and get a fine
Over 0.5 per mille leads to losing the licence and a heavy fine.
After drinking, how does the alcohol in your blood go down?
Alcohol leaves the body only with time. Coffee or water does not help.
A red light is flashing at a railway crossing. What do you do?
A flashing red light at a railway crossing means stop.
Many faster cars have gathered behind you. What must you do?
Let them pass at a safe place
If you are slow, let others pass at a safe place.
Another car is trying to overtake you. What must you not do?
Do not speed up while someone is overtaking you.
A bus has stopped and children are getting off. What do you do?
Slow down and watch for children
Children getting off may cross unexpectedly. Slow down.
There is a warning sign for moose (elg). When are you especially careful?
Moose move most at dusk and dawn.
You hit a wild animal (like a moose) and it ran away. What must you do?
A collision with a large wild animal must be reported to the police.
What is the phone number for an ambulance in Norway?
What is the phone number for the police in Norway?
What is the phone number for the fire brigade in Norway?
You arrive at an accident. What do you do first?
Make the scene safe (hazard lights, triangle), then help
First make the scene safe so no more accidents happen, then help and call.
A person is unconscious but breathing normally. How do you place them?
Put an unconscious person who breathes on their side, so the airway stays open.
A person is unconscious and not breathing. What do you do?
Only put them on their side
Call 113 and start CPR: 30 chest compressions and 2 breaths.
In CPR for an adult, how many chest compressions and how many breaths?
30 chest compressions, then 2 breaths, again and again.
A person is bleeding heavily. What do you do first?
Press directly and hard on the wound
Press directly on the wound to stop the bleeding.
You were in a traffic accident and someone is hurt. What is your duty?
If you are involved in an accident you must stop and help.
An accident with no injured people, only damage. What do you do?
Exchange names and insurance details and fill in an accident report (skademelding)
Exchange details and fill in the damage report together.
You hit a parked car with nobody in it. What do you do?
Find the owner or leave your details and tell the police
You must find the owner or leave your details, and tell the police if needed.
In Norway, how fast must a vehicle at least be able to drive to use the motorway (motorvei)?
Only vehicles that can and may drive at least 40 km/h are allowed on the motorway.
May you reverse or make a U-turn on the motorway?
Yes, if you missed the exit
Reversing or U-turns on the motorway are not allowed.
Entering the motorway, what do you do on the acceleration lane?
Match your speed to the traffic and merge safely
On the acceleration lane, match your speed to the traffic and merge safely.
You missed your exit on the motorway. What do you do?
Stop at the side and turn back
What is important when driving in a tunnel?
Keep distance, no U-turns, no overtaking (unless signs allow)
In a tunnel keep distance, do not turn around, follow the signs.
There is a fire in a tunnel. What do you do?
Stop, turn off the engine, leave the key, walk to the emergency exit
Turn off the engine, leave the key in the car and walk to the emergency exit.
Traffic has stopped in a tunnel. What do you do?
Keep distance, turn off the engine if it takes long, listen to the radio
Keep distance, turn off the engine if it takes long, listen to the radio for information.
In Norway, what is the minimum age for a class B licence?
The minimum age for class B is 18 years.
From what age is practice driving with family (øvelseskjøring) allowed?
Practice driving for class B is allowed from 16, after the basic traffic course.
What is the minimum age of the person who goes with you in practice driving?
The person with you must be at least 25 years old.
For how many years without a break must that person have held a licence?
They must have held a licence for at least 5 years without a break.
How long is the probation period (prøvetid) after the first licence?
In general, how many points (prikker) within 3 years make you lose your licence?
With 8 points within 3 years you lose your licence for six months.
With a B licence, how heavy a trailer may you tow without extra rules?
With B a trailer up to 750 kg, or car and trailer together up to 3500 kg.
With a B licence, what total weight of car and trailer is allowed (trailer over 750 kg)?
With B up to 3500 kg in total. With code 96 up to 4250 kg.
What does code 96 (B96) on the licence allow?
Car and trailer up to 4250 kg in total
B96 allows car and trailer up to 4250 kg in total.
Is it required to carry the licence when you drive?
You must carry your licence when you drive.
What insurance must every car on the road have?
Liability insurance is required for every car.
When is the first EU control (periodic inspection) of a private car?
First inspection after 4 years, then every 2 years.
When do you check the tyre pressure (dekktrykk)?
Check the tyre pressure when the tyres are cold.
What does low tyre pressure lead to?
Worse control, more fuel and tyre damage
Low pressure makes control worse, uses more fuel and damages the tyres.
How do you choose window washer fluid (spylevæske) in winter?
One that does not freeze in the cold
In winter use washer fluid that can stand the cold.
How do you get the best fuel saving?
Steady speed, high gear, looking ahead
Steady speed, high gear and looking ahead save fuel.
What helps when you meet a cyclist on a dark road?
Using the horn again and again
Slowing down and giving plenty of room
Slow down and give plenty of room when passing.
What is important when overtaking a cyclist?
Giving plenty of room, waiting if there is oncoming traffic
Give plenty of room and wait until it is safe.
What do you especially watch when you turn right?
Cyclists and pedestrians on your right
When turning right, watch for cyclists and pedestrians on your right.
When you turn left, who do you give way to?
Oncoming traffic going straight or turning right
When turning left, give way to oncoming traffic.
Where do you stop at a STOP sign?
At the stop line (or before the crossing if there is no line)
In the middle of the crossing
Stop completely at the stop line. If there is no line, before the crossing.
At a STOP sign with no traffic, may you pass without stopping?
At STOP you must always stop completely.
A road with no speed limit
A road that has priority at crossings
Those on a priority road have priority at crossings.
When you drive out of a car park or a driveway (avkjørsel) onto the road, who goes first?
When leaving a driveway or car park, give way to all traffic.
The light is red and there is a stop line before it. Where do you stop?
In the middle of the crossing
A police officer raises one hand straight up. What does it mean?
A raised hand means all traffic must stop.
In winter there is snow on the car roof before you start. What do you do?
Remove it so it does not fall and block your view
Only take it to a garage
Snow on the roof can fall down or block those behind. Remove it.
How does the braking distance change when there is ice on the road?
On ice the braking distance can be many times longer. Slow down and keep more distance.
You meet cars on a narrow road (one lane). What do you do?
Stop at the nearest passing place (møteplass) and let them pass
The one closest to a passing place stops there and lets the other pass.
On a narrow mountain road you meet a large truck. What is usually better?
You reverse to a passing place, it is easier
A small car can reverse more easily – help safely.
How do you drive down a long slope in the mountains?
In a low gear, using the engine to brake
Only with the brakes all the time
Use a low gear so the brakes do not overheat.
You have parked your car on a ferry (ferje). What do you do?
Turn off the engine and put on the handbrake
Turn off the engine, put on the handbrake and follow the crew's instructions.
How must a load on a car or trailer be?
Tied down firmly so it does not fall or move
The load must be tied down firmly so it does not move when you brake.
How many passengers may you carry in a car?
Only as many as there are seats with belts
Only as many as there are seats with belts.
What responsibility does the driver have for passengers under 15?
Making sure they use a belt or child seat
The driver is responsible that passengers under 15 use a belt or child seat.
A rear-facing child seat is in the front. What must the airbag on that seat be?
The airbag must be switched off – it can hurt the child.
What is the danger of leaving children alone in the car in summer?
The car can get hot quickly – it is dangerous
The inside of the car heats up quickly – dangerous for children and animals.
How do you carry a dog in the car?
Safely (in a box or with an animal belt)
Secure animals so they do not fall forward when braking or distract you.
What special care does an electric car need at low speed?
Pedestrians may not hear it – be careful
Electric cars are quiet. Watch out for pedestrians and children.
What about using cruise control in rain or on ice?
Not advised – you can lose control
Do not use cruise control on a slippery road.
How should the head restraint (nakkestøtte) be set?
Its top level with the top of the head
The head restraint should be level with the top of the head to protect the neck.
When do you adjust the seat and mirrors?
Adjust the seat, wheel and mirrors before you start.
When parking on a hill next to the kerb (fortauskant), how do you turn the wheels?
Towards the kerb so the car stops if it moves
Turn the wheels so the car stops against the kerb if it starts to roll.
What do you do after parking on a hill?
Put on the handbrake and put it in gear
Put on the handbrake and put it in gear or P.
What can happen if you drive far over the speed limit?
A fine, points or losing the licence
Driving far over the limit leads to a fine, points or losing the licence.
Visibility is poor in fog. What do you do?
Slow down, keep more distance, use low beam
In fog slow down, keep more distance and use low beam.
At night an oncoming car with high beam dazzles you. Where do you look?
At the right edge of the road
Look at the right edge of the road and slow down.
At night with low beam, from how far is a pedestrian without a reflector usually seen?
A pedestrian without a reflector is usually seen only at 25–30 metres with low beam.
There is strong wind on a bridge or in an open area. What do you do?
Slow down and hold the wheel firmly
In strong wind slow down and hold the wheel with both hands.
What special danger does the first rain after a long dry period have?
The road can be slippery (oil and dust)
The first rain with oil and dust makes the road slippery.
What is special about bridges in winter?
They can freeze before other roads
Bridges cool down quickly – there can be ice.
The mirrors show you what is behind. What must you remember?
Mirrors do not show everything. Looking over your shoulder is needed.
A large truck (lastebil) turns right with a cyclist on its right. What is the danger?
The driver may not see the cyclist (blind spot)
Large vehicles have big blind spots. Cyclists and pedestrians should not come close.
Children are playing at the side of the road. What do you do?
Use the horn and go on
Slow down and be ready for sudden movement
Children may cross unexpectedly. Slow down.
What do you keep in mind when elderly pedestrians are crossing?
They may need more time – be patient
Elderly people may take more time. Be patient.
A person with a white cane (hvit stokk) wants to cross. What does it show?
The person is blind or sees poorly – stop and let them cross
A white cane means the person is blind or sees poorly. Be especially careful.
What do you do at road works (veiarbeid)?
Follow the given speed and signs, watch for workers
At road works follow the signs and the speed.
At road works a person signals with a red flag or a STOP sign. What do you do?
Follow the road worker's signal: stop.
There is a snow plough (brøytebil) on the road. What do you do?
Keep distance and pass only carefully
Keep distance – it throws snow and salt. Pass only when it is safe.
What is needed when you reverse (rygging) on a road?
Slowly, looking carefully, with a helper if needed
Reverse slowly and carefully, with a helper if needed.
When is a U-turn (U-sving) not allowed?
Where you cannot see (curve, top of a hill) or where a sign forbids it
A U-turn is not allowed where you cannot see or where a sign forbids it.
When do you slow down for a curve (sving)?
In the middle of the curve
Slow down before the curve, then use a little gas in it.
May you overtake at the top of a hill (bakketopp)?
No – you cannot see oncoming traffic
Overtaking where you cannot see, like the top of a hill, is not allowed.
Is overtaking at a crossing generally allowed?
Generally not, unless on a priority road or controlled by lights
Overtaking at crossings is generally not allowed, unless on a priority road or with lights.
What about changing lanes again and again (zig-zag)?
Changing lanes again and again increases danger and saves no time.
If a door is not closed or a passenger has no belt, what does the driver do?
Makes sure everything is safe before starting
Before you start, check that doors are closed and belts are fastened.
What do you do when you open the car door towards the road?
Look first that no bikes or cars are coming
Before opening the door, look that no bikes or cars are coming.
What about leaving the engine running without reason (tomgang) in town?
Not advised and pollutes a lot
Do not leave the engine running without reason – it adds pollution.
To make sure you see well, how must the windows be?
Clean and free of snow and ice
All windows must be clean and free of snow and ice.
The window mists up inside (dugg). What do you do?
Only wipe it with your hand
Turn the AC/warm air onto the window
Turn warm air and AC onto the window – the mist goes quickly.
A brake light (bremselys) does not work. What do you do?
Only do not drive at night
Brake lights are important. Have it fixed before driving.
If you are tired on the road, what helps best?
A short nap (15–20 minutes) in a safe place
A short nap in a safe place is the best against tiredness.
What effect does eating or drinking while driving have?
It lowers attention and increases danger
Eating while driving takes your attention. Eat during a break.
When is it best to set the navigation (GPS)?
Before you start or when stopped
Set the navigation before you start.
What reduces the need for sudden braking?
Lots of distance, attention and looking ahead
Distance and looking ahead prevent sudden braking.
The speed limit is 80 km/h, but the road is covered with ice. What do you do?
Adapt your speed to the road (lower)
The speed limit is only the maximum. Adapt your speed to the road conditions.
In town without a sign it is 50 km/h. What is often found near schools?
Near schools and residential areas there is often 30 km/h with a sign.
On a one-way street (enveiskjørt), on which side may you park?
On a one-way street parking is allowed on both sides, unless a sign forbids it.
May you park in front of someone's driveway or garage?
No – do not block the exit
Do not park in front of a driveway or exit.
When parking on a road with a solid middle line, what must you think of?
At least 3 metres must be left in the lane so others do not cross the solid line
In general at least 3 metres must be left between your car and the solid line.
Does a «no parking» (parkering forbudt) sign allow stopping (stans)?
A short stop (to let people out or in) is allowed
No parking means a short stop to let people or goods out is allowed.
What does a «no stopping» (stans forbudt) sign mean?
Not even a short stop is allowed (unless traffic forces you)
No stopping means you may not stop even to let people out.
May you park in a disabled (HC) space without a permit?
Parking in a disabled space without a special permit is not allowed.
May you park or drive in a bicycle lane (sykkelfelt)?
Cars may not drive or park in a bicycle lane.
A cyclist comes on the bicycle path and you turn right across it. Who goes first?
When turning, give way to cyclists going straight.
Outside town, how far before the danger does a warning sign (fareskilt) usually stand?
Outside towns warning signs usually stand 150–250 metres before the danger.
In Norway, may you turn right at a red light?
No, unless there is a green arrow
In Norway turning right on red is not allowed.
In a tunnel or on a narrow bridge without a sign, how fast do you drive?
A speed suited to the conditions
Always drive at a speed suited to the conditions.
What must you check before overtaking?
No oncoming traffic, enough distance, nobody behind is overtaking
Before overtaking, check oncoming traffic, distance and who is behind you.
The car in front of you is overtaking. May you overtake at the same time?
Not advised – you see too little
Overtaking several cars at once is dangerous.
After overtaking, when do you go back to your lane?
When you see the car you passed in the inside mirror
Right in front of that car
Go back safely when you see the car you passed in your inside mirror.
May you overtake on the right on the motorway?
Generally overtake on the left. Queues in several lanes are different.
Staying in the left lane on the motorway without overtaking?
Not advised – go back to the right
After overtaking, go back to the right lane.
When may you stop on the motorway shoulder (skulder)?
Stop on the motorway shoulder only in emergencies.
If the car breaks down on the motorway, where should people wait?
Beside the car on the road
Away from the road behind the barrier (rekkverk)
People should wait away from the road behind the barrier.
What happens if you let someone without a licence drive your car?
Letting someone without a licence drive is illegal.
After buying a car, when must it have insurance?
There must be insurance before the first drive.
The brake pedal feels soft (long travel). What does it show?
There may be a brake problem – have it checked quickly
If the brakes feel different, have them checked quickly.
The engine oil warning light comes on on the dashboard. What do you do?
Stop safely, turn off the engine, check the oil
A red oil light means you must stop quickly.
In general, what must tyres have in common?
The same type and tread on one axle
On one axle the tyres must be the same.
In heavy snow and ice on hills
Chains help in heavy snow and on hills.
When towing a car with a rope (slep), what must the towed car have?
A driver with a licence, working brakes and steering
The towed car needs a driver with a licence and working brakes and steering.
What protects someone who helps at an accident?
By law, someone who helps in good faith is not punished
Someone who helps in good faith is generally not punished. Help.
How long does a speed limit sign apply?
Until a new speed sign or an end-of-limit sign
A speed limit applies until a new sign.
What changes when you drive with a trailer?
Braking distance gets longer and you need wider turns
With a trailer the braking distance gets longer and you need wider turns.
What do you check before towing a trailer?
Trailer lights, coupling, tyres and load
Check the lights, coupling, tyres and load.
The load sticks out far behind the car. What is needed?
A marker (red flag or light) at the end of the load
A load sticking out behind must be marked.
What does a very heavy load in a roof box (takboks) affect?
The car's handling, especially in curves and wind
A heavy load on the roof makes handling worse. Check the roof weight limit.
The number of lanes goes down, shown by a sign. How do you react?
Change to the continuing lane in time, or merge like a zipper
Change only at the very end
Prepare in time and merge like a zipper.
In a traffic queue an ambulance needs to pass. What do you do?
Move to the side safely to open a way
Even in a queue, move aside to open a way.
In Norway, what happens if you are caught driving with a phone in your hand?
Using a phone in your hand leads to a fine and points.
Writing a message at 80 km/h, if you do not look for 3 seconds, how far do you travel?
80 km/h is about 22 m/s – in 3 seconds about 65 metres without looking.
What do you expect when you pass a bus stopped at a stop?
People may suddenly cross in front of the bus – slow down
At a stopped bus, people may cross in front of it.
You meet a horse with a rider on the road. What do you do?
Slow down and pass slowly with plenty of room
Animals can get scared. Pass slowly and with plenty of room.
You meet cattle or sheep on the road. What do you do?
Drive slowly, be ready to stop
Drive slowly and be ready to stop.
At night you park on a dark road without street lights. What do you do?
When parking in the dark on an unlit road, use the parking lights.
One headlight is broken. May you drive at night?
Not advised – have it fixed quickly
With one light others may think you are a motorbike. Have it fixed.
There is loose gravel (grus) on the road. What do you do?
Slow down, avoid sudden braking or steering
On gravel the tyres grip less. Slow down and drive smoothly.
A wheel has gone off the road onto the gravel edge. What do you do?
Lift off the gas and steer back gently
Turn the wheel hard at once
Do not turn suddenly – lift off the gas and come back gently.
Entering a dark tunnel, what helps the eyes adjust?
Slow down before entering, turn on lights
The eyes take time to adjust. Slow down.
What does a short check before every drive (pre-trip) include?
Look at lights, tyres, windows and brakes before you drive.
In heavy rain, how do you change the distance to the car in front?
In rain the braking distance is longer – increase the distance.
Driving at 50 km/h in town, a child suddenly runs into the road. What helps you most?
Low speed and full attention make the stopping distance shorter.
At a crossing without signs or lights, a cyclist comes on the road from your right. Who goes first?
The right-hand rule also applies to cyclists on the road.
When do you use the indicator (blinklys)?
In the middle of the turn
Before turning or changing lanes, in good time
Indicate in good time so others understand you.
Does using the indicator give you priority?
No – the priority rules still apply
The indicator only gives information, not priority.
At a give-way sign (vikeplikt) with no traffic, must you stop?
No – if it is safe you may go on
At a give-way sign you do not have to stop if there is no traffic (unlike STOP).
You have an unpaid speeding fine from last year. Can it cause problems when renewing your licence?
Yes – unpaid fines can cause problems
Unpaid fines can cause problems when renewing documents. Pay on time.
What are the signs of black ice (svart is) on the road?
The road looks black and shiny, and it is freezing
Black ice is invisible – the road just looks wet. Be careful in frost.
You were in an accident. What about drinking alcohol within 6 hours?
Not allowed – the police may test you
After an accident the police may test you. Do not drink alcohol.
On the motorway, in traffic, a red X lights up above a lane. What does it mean?
The lane is closed – change lanes
A red X means the lane is closed. Change safely to another lane.
A child rides a bicycle unsteadily on the road. What do you do?
Slow down, give plenty of room, be ready to stop
Children may move unexpectedly. Give plenty of room.
What does a driver do all the time to keep good attention?
Looks far ahead and checks the mirrors regularly
Look far and near, and check the mirrors regularly.
What helps most to see pedestrians without reflectors at night?
High beam when there is no oncoming traffic
Use high beam when there is no oncoming traffic – pedestrians are seen sooner.

Bil og tilhenger opptil 4250 kg til sammen
B96 gir lov til bil og tilhenger opptil 4250 kg til sammen.
Er det påbudt å ha med førerkortet når du kjører?
Du skal ha førerkortet med deg når du kjører.
Hvilken forsikring må alle biler på veien ha?
Ansvarsforsikring er påbudt for alle biler.
Når er første EU-kontroll av en personbil?
Første kontroll etter 4 år, deretter hvert 2. år.
Sjekk dekktrykket når dekkene er kalde.
Dårligere kjøreegenskaper, mer drivstoff og dekkskader
Lavt trykk gir dårligere kontroll, høyere forbruk og skader dekkene.
Hvordan velger du spylevæske om vinteren?
En som ikke fryser i kulda
Om vinteren: bruk spylevæske som tåler kulde.
Jevn fart, høyt gir, se langt fram
Jevn fart, høyt gir og å se langt fram sparer drivstoff.
Hva hjelper når du møter en syklist på en mørk vei?
Senke farten og gi god plass
Senk farten og gi god plass når du kjører forbi.
Hva er viktig når du kjører forbi en syklist?
Gi god plass, vente hvis det kommer møtende trafikk
Gi god plass og vent til det er trygt.
Hva ser du spesielt etter når du svinger til høyre?
Syklister og fotgjengere på høyre side
Når du svinger til høyre: se etter syklister og fotgjengere på høyre side.
Når du svinger til venstre, hvem må du vike for?
Møtende trafikk som kjører rett fram eller svinger til høyre
Når du svinger til venstre, har du vikeplikt for møtende trafikk.
Hvor stopper du ved et STOPP-skilt?
Ved stopplinjen (eller før krysset hvis det ikke er linje)
Stopp helt ved stopplinjen. Er det ingen linje, før krysset.
Ved et STOPP-skilt uten trafikk, kan du kjøre uten å stoppe?
Ved STOPP må du alltid stoppe helt.
En vei som har forkjørsrett i kryss
De som kjører på forkjørsvei, har forkjørsrett i kryssene.
Når du kjører ut fra en parkeringsplass eller en avkjørsel til veien, hvem kjører først?
Når du kjører ut fra en avkjørsel eller parkeringsplass, har du vikeplikt for all trafikk.
Lyset er rødt og det er en stopplinje foran. Hvor stopper du?
En politibetjent løfter én hånd rett opp. Hva betyr det?
En løftet hånd betyr at all trafikk skal stoppe.
Om vinteren ligger det snø på biltaket før du kjører. Hva gjør du?
Fjerner den så den ikke faller ned og hindrer sikten
Snø på taket kan falle ned eller hindre dem bak. Fjern den.
Hvordan endres bremselengden når det er is på veien?
På is kan bremselengden bli mange ganger lengre. Senk farten og hold mer avstand.
Du møter biler på en smal vei (ett felt). Hva gjør du?
Stopper på nærmeste møteplass og slipper dem forbi
Den som er nærmest en møteplass, stopper der og slipper den andre forbi.
På en smal fjellvei møter du en stor lastebil. Hva er vanligvis best?
Du rygger til en møteplass, det er lettere
En liten bil rygger lettere – hjelp til på en trygg måte.
Hvordan kjører du ned en lang bakke på fjellet?
På lavt gir, bruk motoren som brems
Bruk lavt gir så bremsene ikke blir overopphetet.
Du har parkert bilen på en ferje. Hva gjør du?
Slår av motoren og setter på håndbrekket
Slå av motoren, sett på håndbrekket og følg mannskapets beskjeder.
Hvordan skal last på bil eller tilhenger være?
Godt sikret så den ikke faller av eller flytter seg
Lasten skal sikres godt så den ikke flytter seg når du bremser.
Hvor mange passasjerer kan du ha i en bil?
Bare så mange som det er seter med belte
Bare så mange som det er godkjente seter med belte.
Hvilket ansvar har føreren for passasjerer under 15 år?
Å sørge for at de bruker belte eller barnesete
Føreren har ansvar for at passasjerer under 15 år bruker belte eller barnesete.
Et bakovervendt barnesete står foran. Hva må airbagen på det setet være?
Airbagen må være deaktivert – den kan skade barnet.
Hva er faren ved å la barn være alene i bilen om sommeren?
Bilen kan bli fort varm – det er farlig
Det blir fort varmt inne i bilen – farlig for barn og dyr.
Hvordan har du med en hund i bilen?
Sikre dyr så de ikke kastes fram ved bremsing eller forstyrrer deg.
Hvilken ekstra forsiktighet krever en elbil i lav fart?
Fotgjengere hører den kanskje ikke – vær forsiktig
Elbiler er stille. Pass på fotgjengere og barn.
Hva med å bruke cruisekontroll i regn eller på is?
Ikke anbefalt – du kan miste kontrollen
Ikke bruk cruisekontroll på glatt vei.
Toppen i høyde med toppen av hodet
Nakkestøtten skal være i høyde med toppen av hodet for å beskytte nakken.
Når stiller du inn setet og speilene?
Still inn sete, ratt og speil før du kjører.
Når du parkerer i en bakke ved fortauskanten, hvordan vrir du hjulene?
Mot fortauskanten, så bilen stopper hvis den ruller
Vri hjulene så bilen stopper mot fortauskanten hvis den begynner å rulle.
Hva gjør du etter å ha parkert i en bakke?
Setter på håndbrekket og setter bilen i gir
Sett på håndbrekket og sett bilen i gir eller P.
Hva kan skje hvis du kjører mye over fartsgrensen?
Bot, prikker eller tap av førerkort
Å kjøre mye over fartsgrensen gir bot, prikker eller tap av førerkortet.
Sikten er dårlig i tåke. Hva gjør du?
Senker farten, holder større avstand, bruker nærlys
I tåke: senk farten, hold større avstand og bruk nærlys.
Om natten blender en møtende bil med fjernlys. Hvor ser du?
Se mot høyre veikant og senk farten.
Om natten med nærlys, på hvor lang avstand ser du vanligvis en fotgjenger uten refleks?
En fotgjenger uten refleks ses vanligvis bare på 25–30 meter med nærlys.
Det er sterk vind på en bro eller et åpent område. Hva gjør du?
Senker farten og holder godt i rattet
I sterk vind: senk farten og hold rattet med begge hender.
Hvilken spesiell fare har det første regnet etter en lang tørkeperiode?
Veien kan bli glatt (olje og støv)
Det første regnet med olje og støv gjør veien glatt.
Hva er spesielt med broer om vinteren?
De kan fryse før andre veier
Broer kjøles raskt ned – det kan være is.
Speilene viser deg det som er bak. Hva må du huske?
Speilene viser ikke alt. Skuldertitt er nødvendig.
En stor lastebil svinger til høyre med en syklist på høyre side. Hva er faren?
Store kjøretøy har store blindsoner. Syklister og fotgjengere bør holde avstand.
Barn leker ved veikanten. Hva gjør du?
Senker farten og er klar for plutselige bevegelser
Barn kan krysse uventet. Senk farten.
Hva tenker du på når eldre fotgjengere krysser?
De kan trenge mer tid – vær tålmodig
Eldre kan bruke mer tid. Vær tålmodig.
En person med hvit stokk vil krysse. Hva viser det?
Personen er blind eller svaksynt – stopp og slipp personen over
Hvit stokk betyr at personen er blind eller svaksynt. Vær ekstra forsiktig.
Følger skiltet fart og skilt, passer på arbeiderne
Ved veiarbeid: følg skilt og fart.
Ved veiarbeid dirigerer en person med rødt flagg eller STOPP-skilt. Hva gjør du?
Det er en brøytebil på veien. Hva gjør du?
Holder avstand og kjører bare forsiktig forbi
Hold avstand – den kaster snø og salt. Kjør bare forbi når det er trygt.
Hva trengs når du rygger på en vei?
Sakte, se godt etter, med en hjelper ved behov
Rygg sakte og forsiktig, med hjelper ved behov.
Når er det ikke lov å snu (U-sving)?
Der du ikke ser (sving, bakketopp) eller der skilt forbyr det
Det er ikke lov å snu der du ikke ser, eller der skilt forbyr det.
Når senker du farten for en sving?
Senk farten før svingen, og gi litt gass i den.
Er det lov å kjøre forbi på en bakketopp?
Nei – du ser ikke møtende trafikk
Forbikjøring der du ikke ser, som på en bakketopp, er ikke lov.
Er det vanligvis lov å kjøre forbi i et kryss?
Vanligvis ikke, unntatt på forkjørsvei eller i lysregulert kryss
Forbikjøring i kryss er vanligvis ikke lov, unntatt på forkjørsvei eller ved lysregulering.
Hva med å bytte felt igjen og igjen (sikk-sakk)?
Å bytte felt igjen og igjen øker faren og sparer ingen tid.
Hvis en dør ikke er lukket eller en passasjer ikke har belte, hva gjør føreren?
Sørger for at alt er trygt før start
Før du kjører: sjekk at dørene er lukket og at beltene er på.
Hva gjør du når du åpner bildøra mot veien?
Ser først at ingen sykler eller biler kommer
Før du åpner døra: se at ingen sykler eller biler kommer.
Hva med å la motoren gå uten grunn (tomgang) i byen?
La ikke motoren gå uten grunn – det øker forurensningen.
For å se godt, hvordan må vinduene være?
Rene og fri for snø og is
Alle vinduer skal være rene og fri for snø og is.
Ruta dugger på innsiden. Hva gjør du?
Sett varmluft og AC mot ruta – duggen forsvinner raskt.
Et bremselys virker ikke. Hva gjør du?
Får det reparert før du kjører
Bare unngår å kjøre om natten
Bremselys er viktige. Få det reparert før du kjører.
Hvis du blir trøtt på veien, hva hjelper best?
En kort lur (15–20 minutter) på et trygt sted
En kort lur på et trygt sted er det beste mot trøtthet.
Hvilken virkning har det å spise eller drikke mens du kjører?
Det senker oppmerksomheten og øker faren
Å spise mens du kjører tar oppmerksomheten. Spis i pausen.
Når er det best å stille inn navigasjonen (GPS)?
Før du kjører eller når du står stille
Still inn navigasjonen før du kjører.
Hva reduserer behovet for brå bremsing?
God avstand, oppmerksomhet og å se langt fram
Avstand og å se langt fram hindrer brå bremsing.
Fartsgrensen er 80 km/t, men veien er dekket av is. Hva gjør du?
Fartsgrensen er bare den høyeste tillatte. Tilpass farten til føret.
I byen uten skilt er det 50 km/t. Hva finner du ofte ved skoler?
Ved skoler og i boligområder er det ofte skiltet 30 km/t.
I en enveiskjørt gate, på hvilken side kan du parkere?
I enveiskjørt gate er parkering lov på begge sider, hvis ikke skilt forbyr det.
Er det lov å parkere foran noens innkjørsel eller garasje?
Ikke parker foran en innkjørsel eller utkjørsel.
Når du parkerer på en vei med sperrelinje i midten, hva må du tenke på?
Det må være minst 3 meter igjen i feltet, så andre ikke må krysse sperrelinjen
Vanligvis må det være minst 3 meter mellom bilen og sperrelinjen.
Kort stans (for å slippe av eller på folk) er tillatt
Parkering forbudt betyr at kort stans for å slippe av folk eller varer er lov.
Ikke engang kort stans er lov (hvis ikke trafikken tvinger deg)
Stans forbudt betyr at du ikke kan stoppe, ikke engang for å slippe av folk.
Kan du parkere på en HC-plass uten tillatelse?
Parkering på HC-plass uten spesiell tillatelse er ikke lov.
Kan du parkere eller kjøre i sykkelfeltet?
Biler kan ikke kjøre eller parkere i sykkelfeltet.
En syklist kommer på sykkelveien, og du svinger til høyre over den. Hvem kjører først?
Når du svinger, har du vikeplikt for syklister som kjører rett fram.
Utenfor tettbygd strøk, hvor langt før faren står et fareskilt vanligvis?
Utenfor tettbygd strøk står fareskilt vanligvis 150–250 meter før faren.
I Norge, er det lov å svinge til høyre på rødt lys?
Nei, hvis det ikke er grønn pil
I Norge er det ikke lov å svinge til høyre på rødt.
I en tunnel eller på en smal bro uten skilt, hvor fort kjører du?
Kjør alltid i en fart som passer forholdene.
Hva må du sjekke før du kjører forbi?
Ingen møtende trafikk, nok avstand, ingen bak deg kjører forbi
Før forbikjøring: sjekk møtende trafikk, avstand og hvem som er bak deg.
Bilen foran deg kjører forbi. Kan du kjøre forbi samtidig?
Ikke anbefalt – du ser for lite
Å kjøre forbi flere biler på en gang er farlig.
Etter forbikjøring, når går du tilbake til feltet ditt?
Når du ser bilen du kjørte forbi, i innvendig speil
Gå trygt tilbake når du ser bilen du kjørte forbi, i det innvendige speilet.
Er det lov å kjøre forbi på høyre side på motorvei?
Kjør vanligvis forbi på venstre side. Kø i flere felt er noe annet.
Å bli i venstre felt på motorveien uten å kjøre forbi?
Ikke anbefalt – gå tilbake til høyre
Etter forbikjøring: gå tilbake til høyre felt.
Når kan du stoppe på skulderen på motorveien?
Stopp på motorveiens skulder bare i nødstilfeller.
Hvis bilen stopper på motorveien, hvor skal folk vente?
Ved siden av bilen i veibanen
Folk skal vente unna veien, bak autovernet.
Hva skjer hvis du lar noen uten førerkort kjøre bilen din?
Å la noen uten førerkort kjøre er ulovlig.
Når du har kjøpt en bil, når må den være forsikret?
Den må være forsikret før første tur.
Bremsepedalen føles myk (lang pedalvei). Hva viser det?
Det kan være feil på bremsene – få dem sjekket raskt
Føles bremsene annerledes, få dem sjekket raskt.
Varsellampen for motorolje lyser på dashbordet. Hva gjør du?
Stopper trygt, slår av motoren, sjekker oljen
Rød oljelampe betyr at du må stoppe raskt.
Hva må dekkene vanligvis ha til felles?
Samme type og mønster på samme aksel
På samme aksel skal dekkene være like.
Ved mye snø og is i bakker
Kjetting hjelper ved mye snø og i bakker.
Når du sleper en bil med tau, hva må bilen som blir slept, ha?
En fører med førerkort, virkende bremser og styring
Bilen som slepes, trenger en fører med førerkort og virkende bremser og styring.
Hva beskytter en som hjelper ved en ulykke?
Etter loven straffes ikke den som hjelper i god tro
Den som hjelper i god tro, straffes vanligvis ikke. Hjelp.
Til et nytt fartsskilt eller et skilt for slutt på fartsgrensen
En fartsgrense gjelder til et nytt skilt.
Hva endres når du kjører med tilhenger?
Bremselengden blir lengre og du trenger bredere svinger
Med tilhenger blir bremselengden lengre, og du trenger bredere svinger.
Hva sjekker du før du kjører med tilhenger?
Lys på tilhengeren, kobling, dekk og last
Sjekk lys, kobling, dekk og last.
Lasten stikker langt ut bak bilen. Hva trengs?
Merking (rødt flagg eller lys) ytterst på lasten
Last som stikker ut bak, skal merkes.
Hva påvirker en veldig tung last i takboksen?
Bilens kjøreegenskaper, særlig i svinger og vind
Tung last på taket gir dårligere kjøreegenskaper. Sjekk tillatt taklast.
Antall felt blir færre, vist med skilt. Hvordan reagerer du?
Bytter i god tid til feltet som fortsetter, eller fletter som en glidelås
Forbered deg i god tid og flett som en glidelås.
I kø må en ambulanse komme forbi. Hva gjør du?
Kjører trygt til siden for å lage en vei
Også i kø: flytt deg til siden for å lage en vei.
I Norge, hva skjer hvis du blir tatt med mobilen i hånda mens du kjører?
Å bruke mobilen i hånda gir bot og prikker.
Du skriver en melding i 80 km/t og ser ikke opp på 3 sekunder. Hvor langt kjører du?
80 km/t er omtrent 22 m/s – på 3 sekunder omtrent 65 meter uten å se.
Hva venter du deg når du kjører forbi en buss som står på holdeplassen?
Folk kan plutselig krysse foran bussen – senk farten
Ved en buss som står stille, kan folk krysse foran den.
Du møter en hest med rytter på veien. Hva gjør du?
Senker farten og kjører sakte forbi med god plass
Dyr kan bli skremt. Kjør sakte forbi og med god plass.
Du møter kyr eller sauer på veien. Hva gjør du?
Kjører sakte, klar til å stoppe
Kjør sakte og vær klar til å stoppe.
Om natten parkerer du på en mørk vei uten gatelys. Hva gjør du?
Når du parkerer i mørket på en vei uten belysning, bruk parkeringslys.
Den ene frontlykta er ødelagt. Kan du kjøre om natten?
Ikke anbefalt – få den reparert raskt
Med bare én lykt kan andre tro at du er en motorsykkel. Få den reparert.
Det er løs grus på veien. Hva gjør du?
Senker farten, unngår brå bremsing eller styring
På grus har dekkene mindre grep. Senk farten og kjør jevnt.
Et hjul har kommet ut på grusen i veikanten. Hva gjør du?
Slipper gassen og styrer forsiktig tilbake
Vrir rattet kraftig med en gang
Ikke vri brått – slipp gassen og kom forsiktig tilbake.
Når du kjører inn i en mørk tunnel, hva hjelper øynene å venne seg til mørket?
Senke farten før tunnelen, slå på lys
Hva inneholder en kort sjekk før hver tur?
Se på lys, dekk, vinduer og bremser før du kjører.
I kraftig regn, hvordan endrer du avstanden til bilen foran?
I regn er bremselengden lengre – øk avstanden.
Du kjører i 50 km/t i byen, og et barn løper plutselig ut i veien. Hva hjelper deg mest?
Lav fart og å se langt fram
Lav fart og full oppmerksomhet gir kortere stopplengde.
I et kryss uten skilt eller lys kommer en syklist på veien fra høyre. Hvem kjører først?
Høyreregelen gjelder også for syklister i veibanen.
Før du svinger eller skifter felt, i god tid
Blink i god tid så andre forstår deg.
Blinklyset gir bare informasjon, ikke forkjørsrett.
Ved et vikepliktskilt uten trafikk, må du stoppe?
Nei – hvis det er trygt, kan du kjøre videre
Ved vikepliktskilt må du ikke stoppe hvis det ikke er trafikk (ulikt STOPP).
Du har en ubetalt fartsbot fra i fjor. Kan det gi problemer når du fornyer førerkortet?
Ja – ubetalte bøter kan gi problemer
Ubetalte bøter kan gi problemer når du fornyer dokumenter. Betal i tide.
Hva er tegnene på svart is på veien?
Veien ser svart og blank ut, og det er kuldegrader
Svart is synes ikke – veien ser bare våt ut. Vær forsiktig ved kuldegrader.
Du var med i en ulykke. Hva med å drikke alkohol innen 6 timer?
Ikke lov – politiet kan teste deg
Etter en ulykke kan politiet teste deg. Ikke drikk alkohol.
På motorveien, i kø, lyser et rødt kryss over et felt. Hva betyr det?
Rødt kryss betyr at feltet er stengt. Bytt trygt til et annet felt.
Et barn sykler ustøtt på veien. Hva gjør du?
Senker farten, gir god plass, er klar til å stoppe
Barn kan bevege seg uventet. Gi god plass.
Hva gjør en fører hele tiden for å holde god oppmerksomhet?
Ser langt fram og sjekker speilene jevnlig
Se langt og nær, og sjekk speilene jevnlig.
Hva hjelper mest for å se fotgjengere uten refleks om natten?
Fjernlys når det ikke er møtende trafikk
Bruk fjernlys når det ikke er møtende trafikk – fotgjengere ses tidligere.
